title: Community | Saltay Hanalei Bay
description: Community offerings at Saltay Botanical Spa: Kama’aina rates, Kupuna healing days, workshops, community spa days, and group experiences.
heading: Community
introduction: Care, connection, and shared experiences for those who live and work in our community.

sections.heading: Kama’aina Rates
sections.body_html: Special Kama’aina Rates are offered to full time residents who live and work in the community. Please inquire.

sections.heading: Kupuna / Community Healing Days
sections.body_html:
Offered 1st Saturday of every month (coincides with Surf Swap) · 10AM to 2PM

1 healing modality for $50 | 2 healing modalities for $85

Modality Options:

  • Acupuncture / Acupressure
  • Fire Cupping
  • Tui Na Massage
  • Cranial Sacral Therapy / Reiki
  • Gua Sha – Psoas Release
  • Botanical Compress / Hot Stones
  • Steam Therapy

sections.heading: Special Events
sections.body_html: SALTAY BOTANICAL SPA offers community events for those who live and work in our community.

sections.heading: Community Experiences
sections.body_html:
Please schedule an appointment.

sections.heading: Workshops / Classes
sections.body_html: Sign up for our mailing list or check out our Instagram page for upcoming training.

sections.heading: Community Spa Days
sections.body_html:
Offered to the community on specifically chosen dates – see calendar for upcoming CSD, Community Spa Days.

  • 60 min: $111 (The Saltay Experience with Signature Spa Body Treatment)
  • 30 min: $75 (The Saltay Experience Herbal Botanical Foot Soak with Far Infra-red Sauna)
  • 90 min: $150 (Saltay Experience with Botanical Spa Body Treatment)

(Spa Experiences are offered in a community setting and treatments may be done in a shared room if the person receiving the session comes in alone. Private rooms granted to those who come with a friend or family member.)

sections.heading: Group Spa Experiences
sections.body_html:
Are you planning a ceremony, retreat, wedding, or other group event?

Contact us to plan a customized group spa experience.
